record.reason: Supernova is a 650M decoder-only model combining RoPE, 3:1 GQA and a custom 128k BPE tokenizer to reach 90% of 1B-model performance with 35% fewer parameters and 100B training tokens; GQA/tokenizer choices are inference-relevant, but the paper reports model quality versus training budget, not inference latency or serving behavior.
record.title: Supernova: Achieving More with Less in Transformer Architectures
